text:
maya: Heads up — eu-central-2 GPU pool dipping after tonight's privatelink + role-boundary cutover. Node bootstrap failing during KMS decrypt.
navid: Seeing ~20% boot failures. Keystore logs show AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt.
olga: Snippet (redacted):
```
ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: Condition check failed: kms:EncryptionContext 'environment=prod' required
at keystore/agent.go:203
```
maya: The policy change enforced EncryptionContext keys for the keystore privatelink endpoint. Our bootstrap agent doesn't populate that field.
compliance: That was intentional to prevent dev VPCs from hitting prod keystore. We scoped by aws:SourceVpc and kms:EncryptionContext:environment=prod. Might be too strict for boot flows.
navid: Impact: region pool at ~65% desired -> autoscaler launching elsewhere -> cross-region prewarm + egress. Finance estimate ~1.6k/hr extra if this continues. Tagging @finance.
finance: noted, watching. Escalate if >30m.
olga: Quick mitigations: 1) revert endpoint policy for eu-central-2 2) add temporary Allow for role edge-bootstrap scoped to keystore ARN 3) patch bootstrap agent to include EncryptionContext then roll.
maya: Revert is fastest. Revert window request?
compliance: I can revert the endpoint policy in 4m, add a short-lived exception for edge-bootstrap, and open a follow-up to land the client fix.
ops-bot: Policy revert scheduled for endpoint pl-09f8e2 at 04:12 UTC. Will post status.
navid: Also observed some RSTs from NAT during provisioning which may amplify failures when KMS call retries exceed thresholds. Packet excerpt: `tcp 10.3.5.14:49876 -> keystore-proxy.eu-central-2:443 RST`
maya: If NAT timeouts are too short we see mid-handshake drops. Can infra flip natkeepalive back to previous 300s as a short test?
compliance: prefer revert first. Nat tweak is lower-impact but will do if revert doesn't stabilize.
ops-bot: Revert ran at 04:15 UTC. Endpoint policy restored to pre-cutover state.
olga: Running 100 canary boots now: `for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -sS https://orchestrator/simulate-boot -d '{"region":"eu-central-2"}'; done`
navid: Early numbers: failures dropped from 20% -> 2% within 6 minutes. Looks like revert fixed the immediate problem.
maya: Next steps: 1) schedule bootstrap agent patch to include EncryptionContext and ship in next patch window 2) update policy rollout playbook to detect keystore-dependent flows and require explicit allowlist for boot roles 3) add integration test that simulates boot KMS calls with and without EncryptionContext.
compliance: I'll add the allowlist gating and a policy unit test. Also will coordinate with Maya on rollout timeline.
finance: keeping the cost watch open for 1h. Please ping if any regressions.
ops-bot: Thread closed for now; will auto-reopen on new keystore denial alerts for eu-central-2.
maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
